caveats: Inputs are the current FRED vintage except payrolls, which uses ALFRED vintages as of the release eve. Seasonal factors and revisions flatter the monthly models slightly.
This measures whether the model's distribution is honest, not whether it beats the market. That needs settled Kalshi ladders (replay-market), of which there are few.
Coverage should be near 0.68 and 0.95; a z stdev far from 1 means sigma is mis-scaled; a lopsided PIT histogram means bias.
